evidence_class: independently downloaded and recomputed industrial-derived data
source_dictionary_discrepancy: Deposit dictionary says fixed-baseline deviations, while deposited scripts distinguish per-CIP dp_pct/ndp_pct from fixed-baseline DP_norm. Keep exact deposited labels; do not assign raw pressure or energy semantics. Upstream derivation cannot be audited without withheld raw data.
central_finding: No trained model passes the predefined research screen. Persistence has the lowest earlier-validation MAE for all target/horizon combinations. The 14-day flux smoothing gain is a later test observation, not a prospectively selected AI result.
role_in_episode: The measured industrial evidence lane: forecasting of published derived indicators, kept separate from synthetic plant physics/energy scenarios.
